name: copy.top MCP
summary: Free read-only remote MCP for live crypto trader signals on fomo, pump.fun and Hyperliquid. Hosted at copy.top/mcp; no key for the public tools.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Polycool LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, per the terms of use). The hosted Streamable HTTP MCP is at https://copy.top/mcp. The docs-and-examples repository github.com/copydottop/mcp is not archived (created 2026-11-14, pushed 2026-11-19) and has no LICENSE file (raw LICENSE is a 14-byte "404: Not Found"; GitHub license is none). The hosted service is proprietary under https://copy.top/terms (HTTP 200). Official README: no key needed for 16 tools at 20 calls a minute; a free API key (created after sign-in on copy.top; not created here) adds 3 webhook tools and 60 calls a minute. The server is read-only: it cannot see an account, place an order or touch a wallet. Official MCP registry name: top.copy/mcp. Docs: https://copy.top/agents (HTTP 200). Connect examples include `claude mcp add --transport http copytop https://copy.top/mcp` (not run). copy.top is independent and, per the README and terms, is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by fomo, pump.fun or Hyperliquid. Figures are data, not advice; most traders lose money. Network/gas fees on the copy-trading product, once submitted to a chain, cannot be refunded; the MCP itself is a free read API. The site loads a Google Ads tag (AW-17870675354) on pages including /license. llms.txt is at https://copy.top/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Queue #42 was submitted by the maker (ana, copy.top); claims were checked against the README, terms, llms.txt and read-only MCP probes. No signup, key, or tool call.
